messages:
anna: RFC follow-up — we need a tighter surface for model version lineage/provenance. Quick callout: a lot of clients assume pinned model IDs are immutable; that breaks soft migrations. Proposal: add `lineage` (ancestors), `provenance` (origin string), and an `immutability_level` enum. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike: If clients expect immutability, caches and KV keys blow up if semantics change. Is 'soft' pin default going to be behind a feature flag or opt-in?

sasha: we have customers relying on hard pins for compliance. cannot flip default globally. but we could default `immutability_level: hard` for `release` channel and `soft` for `canary`/`experimental`.

jin: sketch of schema to discuss (non-normative):
```json
{
  "model_id": "rwd/opt-7b.v3",
  "schema_version": 2,
  "lineage": ["rwd/opt-7b.v2", "rwd/opt-7b.v1"],
  "provenance": "hub://models/rwd/opt-7b@2026-02-20",
  "immutability_level": "soft", // enum: hard | soft | ephemeral
  "migration_window_seconds": 86400,
  "compat_hint": [{"feature": "tokenizer", "score": 0.92}],
  "rollback_token": "sha256:abcdef..."
}
```

mike: migration_window_seconds — SDKs must surface this and honor cache TTLs. Also how do we verify rollback_token? Is it signing by control plane?

anna: rollback_token is an opt-in signed token from control plane to authorize/verify a rollback path. If absent, we fall back to current behavior (no special verification). Also proposing `compat_hint` with a weight so resolver can pick fallbacks more intelligently.

sasha: compat_hint is useful but watch out for client parsing fragility. more fields => more surface area for parsing errors. we should version the schema and do graceful-parse on older clients.

jin: agreed. add `schema_version` and make new fields optional. server will set `schema_version: 2` only when using new semantics; older control plane responses remain `schema_version: 1`.

mike: ops question — how do we measure migration churn? My suggestion: telemetry events `migration.initiated`, `migration.completed`, `migration.rollback` with counts and durations, plus per-tenant tags.

anna: action items: jin to update RFC with schema snippet + backwards-compat guidelines; mike to add telemetry hooks in resolver and cache layer; sasha to draft enterprise migration playbook (opt-in conversion, notices). We'll reconvene next sync. :+1:
